Q1a.en: For the curve \(y^2 = 4x\), differentiating with respect to \(x\) gives \(2y\frac{dy}{dx} = 4\), so its slope is \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{2}{y}\). The line \(y = x + 3\) has slope 1. Setting \(\frac{2}{y} = 1\) gives \(y = 2\), and then \(x = \frac{y^2}{4} = 1\). So the point is \((1, 2)\), which is the choice \((1, 2)\).
Q1a.hi: वक्र \(y^2 = 4x\) का \(x\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर \(2y\frac{dy}{dx} = 4\), अतः वक्र की ढाल \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{2}{y}\) है। रेखा \(y = x + 3\) की ढाल 1 है। \(\frac{2}{y} = 1\) रखने पर \(y = 2\) तथा \(x = \frac{y^2}{4} = 1\)। अतः अभीष्ट बिन्दु \((1, 2)\) है, जो विकल्प \((1, 2)\) है।

Q1b.en: Two perpendicular vectors have zero scalar product, so \((2)(5) + (3)(-\lambda) + (4)(2) = 0\), that is \(18 - 3\lambda = 0\), giving \(\lambda = 6\), which is the choice 6.
Q1b.hi: दो लम्बवत् सदिशों का अदिश गुणनफल शून्य होता है, अतः \((2)(5) + (3)(-\lambda) + (4)(2) = 0\), अर्थात् \(18 - 3\lambda = 0\), जिससे \(\lambda = 6\) प्राप्त होता है, जो विकल्प 6 है।

Q1c.en: Since \(A^2 = A\), also \(A^3 = A^2 \cdot A = A \cdot A = A\). The matrices \(A\) and \(I\) commute, so \((A + I)^3 = A^3 + 3A^2 + 3A + I = A + 3A + 3A + I = 7A + I\). Hence \((A + I)^3 - 7A = I\), which is the choice \(I\) (the identity matrix).
Q1c.hi: चूँकि \(A^2 = A\), अतः \(A^3 = A^2 \cdot A = A \cdot A = A\)। आव्यूह \(A\) तथा \(I\) क्रमविनिमेय हैं, इसलिए \((A + I)^3 = A^3 + 3A^2 + 3A + I = A + 3A + 3A + I = 7A + I\)। अतः \((A + I)^3 - 7A = I\), जो विकल्प \(I\) (तत्समक आव्यूह) है।

Q1d.en: Using \(\cos^2 x = \frac{1 + \cos 2x}{2}\): \(\int \cos^2 x\, dx = \frac{1}{2}\int (1 + \cos 2x)\, dx = \frac{x}{2} + \frac{1}{4}\sin 2x + C\), which is the choice \(\frac{1}{4}\sin 2x + \frac{x}{2} + C\).
Q1d.hi: \(\cos^2 x = \frac{1 + \cos 2x}{2}\) का प्रयोग करने पर \(\int \cos^2 x\, dx = \frac{1}{2}\int (1 + \cos 2x)\, dx = \frac{x}{2} + \frac{1}{4}\sin 2x + C\), जो विकल्प \(\frac{1}{4}\sin 2x + \frac{x}{2} + C\) है।

Q1e.en: If \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\), then \(3x_1 = 3x_2\), so \(x_1 = x_2\): the function is one-one (so it is not many-one). For any real \(y\), the real number \(x = \frac{y}{3}\) gives \(f(x) = y\), so the function is onto. Of the four statements only Onto is true, so the answer is the choice Onto.
Q1e.hi: यदि \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\), तो \(3x_1 = 3x_2\), अतः \(x_1 = x_2\): फलन एकैकी है (इसलिए बहु-एकैकी नहीं है)। किसी भी वास्तविक संख्या \(y\) के लिए वास्तविक संख्या \(x = \frac{y}{3}\) से \(f(x) = y\) प्राप्त होता है, अतः फलन आच्छादक है। चारों कथनों में केवल आच्छादक सत्य है, अतः उत्तर विकल्प आच्छादक है।

Q2a.en:
Given \(y = A + Be^x\), where \(A\) and \(B\) are constants.
Differentiating with respect to \(x\): \(\frac{dy}{dx} = Be^x\).
Differentiating again: \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = Be^x\).
Therefore \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - \frac{dy}{dx} = Be^x - Be^x = 0\). Hence proved.
Q2a.hi:
दिया है \(y = A + Be^x\), जहाँ \(A\) तथा \(B\) अचर हैं।
\(x\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = Be^x\)।
पुनः अवकलन करने पर: \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = Be^x\)।
अतः \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - \frac{dy}{dx} = Be^x - Be^x = 0\)। इति सिद्धम्।

Q2b.en:
Separating the variables: \((y^2 + 1)\, dy = (x^2 - 1)\, dx\).
Integrating both sides: \(\int (y^2 + 1)\, dy = \int (x^2 - 1)\, dx\), so \(\frac{y^3}{3} + y = \frac{x^3}{3} - x + C\), which is the general solution (\(C\) an arbitrary constant).
Q2b.hi:
चरों को पृथक् करने पर: \((y^2 + 1)\, dy = (x^2 - 1)\, dx\)।
दोनों पक्षों का समाकलन करने पर: \(\int (y^2 + 1)\, dy = \int (x^2 - 1)\, dx\), अतः \(\frac{y^3}{3} + y = \frac{x^3}{3} - x + C\), जो अभीष्ट व्यापक हल है (\(C\) एक स्वेच्छ अचर है)।

Q2c.en:
Here \(f(x) = x\) for \(x \ge 0\) and \(f(x) = -x\) for \(x < 0\).
For \(x > 0\) and for \(x < 0\), \(f\) is a polynomial, so it is continuous there.
At \(x = 0\): \(\lim_{x \to 0^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 0^-} (-x) = 0\), \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 0^+} x = 0\) and \(f(0) = 0\). The left limit, right limit and value are equal, so \(f\) is continuous at \(x = 0\).
Hence \(f(x) = |x|\) is continuous for all values of \(x\).

Q2d.en:
P(not A and not B) \(= P(A' \cap B') = P((A \cup B)') = 1 - P(A \cup B)\).
Now \(P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B) = \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{4} - \frac{1}{8} = \frac{5}{8}\).
So P(not A and not B) \(= 1 - \frac{5}{8} = \frac{3}{8}\).
Q2d.hi:
P(A-नहीं और B-नहीं) \(= P(A' \cap B') = P((A \cup B)') = 1 - P(A \cup B)\)।
अब \(P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B) = \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{4} - \frac{1}{8} = \frac{5}{8}\)।
अतः P(A-नहीं और B-नहीं) \(= 1 - \frac{5}{8} = \frac{3}{8}\)।

Q2e.en: \(A \times B\) has \(2 \times 3 = 6\) elements, and every subset of \(A \times B\) is a relation from \(A\) to \(B\). So the number of relations is \(2^6 = 64\).
Q2e.hi: \(A \times B\) में \(2 \times 3 = 6\) अवयव हैं तथा \(A \times B\) का प्रत्येक उपसमुच्चय \(A\) से \(B\) में एक सम्बन्ध है। अतः सम्बन्धों की कुल संख्या \(2^6 = 64\) है।

Q3a.en:
Given \(y = A\cos\theta + B\sin\theta\).
Differentiating with respect to \(\theta\): \(\frac{dy}{d\theta} = -A\sin\theta + B\cos\theta\).
Differentiating again: \(\frac{d^2y}{d\theta^2} = -A\cos\theta - B\sin\theta = -(A\cos\theta + B\sin\theta) = -y\).
Hence \(\frac{d^2y}{d\theta^2} = -y\). Proved.
Q3a.hi:
दिया है \(y = A\cos\theta + B\sin\theta\)।
\(\theta\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर: \(\frac{dy}{d\theta} = -A\sin\theta + B\cos\theta\)।
पुनः अवकलन करने पर: \(\frac{d^2y}{d\theta^2} = -A\cos\theta - B\sin\theta = -(A\cos\theta + B\sin\theta) = -y\)।
अतः \(\frac{d^2y}{d\theta^2} = -y\)। इति सिद्धम्।

Q3b.en:
A line through the point \((x_1, y_1, z_1)\) with direction ratios \(a, b, c\) has Cartesian equation \(\frac{x - x_1}{a} = \frac{y - y_1}{b} = \frac{z - z_1}{c}\).
Here the point is \((3, -2, -5)\) and, since the line is parallel to \(3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 2\hat{k}\), its direction ratios are \(3, 2, -2\).
So the required equation is \(\frac{x - 3}{3} = \frac{y + 2}{2} = \frac{z + 5}{-2}\).
Q3b.hi:
बिन्दु \((x_1, y_1, z_1)\) से गुजरने वाली तथा दिक्-अनुपात \(a, b, c\) वाली रेखा का कार्तीय समीकरण \(\frac{x - x_1}{a} = \frac{y - y_1}{b} = \frac{z - z_1}{c}\) होता है।
यहाँ बिन्दु \((3, -2, -5)\) है तथा रेखा सदिश \(3\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 2\hat{k}\) के समान्तर है, अतः उसके दिक्-अनुपात \(3, 2, -2\) हैं।
अतः अभीष्ट समीकरण \(\frac{x - 3}{3} = \frac{y + 2}{2} = \frac{z + 5}{-2}\) है।

Q3c.en:
Separating the variables: \(dy = e^x\cos x\, dx\), so \(y = \int e^x\cos x\, dx\).
Let \(I = \int e^x\cos x\, dx\). Integrating by parts twice:
\(I = e^x\cos x + \int e^x\sin x\, dx = e^x\cos x + e^x\sin x - \int e^x\cos x\, dx = e^x(\cos x + \sin x) - I\).
So \(2I = e^x(\cos x + \sin x)\), and \(I = \frac{e^x}{2}(\sin x + \cos x)\).
The general solution is \(y = \frac{e^x}{2}(\sin x + \cos x) + C\).
Q3c.hi:
चरों को पृथक् करने पर: \(dy = e^x\cos x\, dx\), अतः \(y = \int e^x\cos x\, dx\)।
माना \(I = \int e^x\cos x\, dx\)। दो बार खण्डशः समाकलन करने पर:
\(I = e^x\cos x + \int e^x\sin x\, dx = e^x\cos x + e^x\sin x - \int e^x\cos x\, dx = e^x(\cos x + \sin x) - I\)।
अतः \(2I = e^x(\cos x + \sin x)\), अर्थात् \(I = \frac{e^x}{2}(\sin x + \cos x)\)।
अतः व्यापक हल \(y = \frac{e^x}{2}(\sin x + \cos x) + C\) है।

Q3d.en:
Since \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c} = \vec{0}\), its scalar product with itself is zero:
\((\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) = 0\)
\(|\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{c}|^2 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = 0\).
Hence \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a} = -\frac{1}{2}\left(|\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{c}|^2\right)\).
(For example, with \(|\vec{a}| = 3\), \(|\vec{b}| = 4\), \(|\vec{c}| = 5\) this gives \(-\frac{1}{2}(9 + 16 + 25) = -25\).)
Q3d.hi:
चूँकि \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c} = \vec{0}\), अतः इसका स्वयं से अदिश गुणनफल शून्य है:
\((\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) = 0\)
\(|\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{c}|^2 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = 0\)।
अतः \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a} = -\frac{1}{2}\left(|\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{c}|^2\right)\)।
(उदाहरण के लिए, \(|\vec{a}| = 3\), \(|\vec{b}| = 4\), \(|\vec{c}| = 5\) होने पर यह मान \(-\frac{1}{2}(9 + 16 + 25) = -25\) है।)

Q4a.en:
Let \(R = R_1 \cap R_2\).
(i) Reflexive: for every \(a \in A\), \((a, a) \in R_1\) and \((a, a) \in R_2\) (both are reflexive), so \((a, a) \in R_1 \cap R_2\).
(ii) Symmetric: if \((a, b) \in R_1 \cap R_2\), then \((a, b) \in R_1\) and \((a, b) \in R_2\). Both are symmetric, so \((b, a) \in R_1\) and \((b, a) \in R_2\), that is \((b, a) \in R_1 \cap R_2\).
(iii) Transitive: if \((a, b), (b, c) \in R_1 \cap R_2\), then \((a, b), (b, c) \in R_1\) and \((a, b), (b, c) \in R_2\). Both are transitive, so \((a, c) \in R_1\) and \((a, c) \in R_2\), that is \((a, c) \in R_1 \cap R_2\).
Being reflexive, symmetric and transitive, \(R_1 \cap R_2\) is an equivalence relation on A.
Q4a.hi:
माना \(R = R_1 \cap R_2\)।
(i) स्वतुल्य: प्रत्येक \(a \in A\) के लिए \((a, a) \in R_1\) तथा \((a, a) \in R_2\) (दोनों स्वतुल्य हैं), अतः \((a, a) \in R_1 \cap R_2\)।
(ii) सममित: यदि \((a, b) \in R_1 \cap R_2\), तो \((a, b) \in R_1\) तथा \((a, b) \in R_2\)। दोनों सममित हैं, अतः \((b, a) \in R_1\) तथा \((b, a) \in R_2\), अर्थात् \((b, a) \in R_1 \cap R_2\)।
(iii) संक्रामक: यदि \((a, b), (b, c) \in R_1 \cap R_2\), तो \((a, b), (b, c) \in R_1\) तथा \((a, b), (b, c) \in R_2\)। दोनों संक्रामक हैं, अतः \((a, c) \in R_1\) तथा \((a, c) \in R_2\), अर्थात् \((a, c) \in R_1 \cap R_2\)।
स्वतुल्य, सममित तथा संक्रामक होने के कारण \(R_1 \cap R_2\), A में एक तुल्यता सम्बन्ध है।

Q4b.en: \(\sin^2 x\) is an even function, so \(\int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2} \sin^2 x\, dx = 2\int_0^{\pi/2} \sin^2 x\, dx = 2\int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{1 - \cos 2x}{2}\, dx = \left[x - \frac{\sin 2x}{2}\right]_0^{\pi/2} = \frac{\pi}{2} - 0 = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Q4b.hi: \(\sin^2 x\) एक सम फलन है, अतः \(\int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2} \sin^2 x\, dx = 2\int_0^{\pi/2} \sin^2 x\, dx = 2\int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{1 - \cos 2x}{2}\, dx = \left[x - \frac{\sin 2x}{2}\right]_0^{\pi/2} = \frac{\pi}{2} - 0 = \frac{\pi}{2}\)।

Q4c.en:
Writing b for boy and g for girl, the sample space is \(S = \{bb, bg, gb, gg\}\), all equally likely.
Let E: both children are boys \(= \{bb\}\), and F: at least one child is a boy \(= \{bb, bg, gb\}\). Then \(E \cap F = \{bb\}\).
\(P(F) = \frac{3}{4}\), \(P(E \cap F) = \frac{1}{4}\).
So \(P(E \mid F) = \frac{P(E \cap F)}{P(F)} = \frac{1/4}{3/4} = \frac{1}{3}\).
Q4c.hi:
लड़के के लिए b तथा लड़की के लिए g लिखने पर प्रतिदर्श समष्टि \(S = \{bb, bg, gb, gg\}\) है, जिसके सभी परिणाम समसंभाव्य हैं।
माना E: दोनों बच्चे लड़के हैं \(= \{bb\}\) तथा F: कम से कम एक बच्चा लड़का है \(= \{bb, bg, gb\}\)। तब \(E \cap F = \{bb\}\)।
\(P(F) = \frac{3}{4}\), \(P(E \cap F) = \frac{1}{4}\)।
अतः \(P(E \mid F) = \frac{P(E \cap F)}{P(F)} = \frac{1/4}{3/4} = \frac{1}{3}\)।

\(f(x) = x^2 - 4x + 6\), so \(f'(x) = 2x - 4 = 2(x - 2)\), and \(f'(x) = 0\) at \(x = 2\). This point divides the real line into \((-\infty, 2)\) and \((2, \infty)\).

Q5a.en:
Here \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 2y & z \\ x & y & -z \\ x & -y & z \end{bmatrix}\), so \(A' = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & x & x \\ 2y & y & -y \\ z & -z & z \end{bmatrix}\).
Multiplying:
\(AA' = \begin{bmatrix} 4y^2 + z^2 & 2y^2 - z^2 & -2y^2 + z^2 \\ 2y^2 - z^2 & x^2 + y^2 + z^2 & x^2 - y^2 - z^2 \\ -2y^2 + z^2 & x^2 - y^2 - z^2 & x^2 + y^2 + z^2 \end{bmatrix}\).
Since \(AA' = I = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\), equating corresponding elements:
\(4y^2 + z^2 = 1\) ... (1)
\(2y^2 - z^2 = 0\) ... (2)
\(x^2 - y^2 - z^2 = 0\) ... (3)
\(x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = 1\) ... (4)
From (2), \(z^2 = 2y^2\). Putting this in (1): \(6y^2 = 1\), so \(y^2 = \frac{1}{6}\) and \(z^2 = \frac{1}{3}\).
From (3), \(x^2 = y^2 + z^2 = \frac{1}{6} + \frac{1}{3} = \frac{1}{2}\). Check in (4): \(\frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{6} + \frac{1}{3} = 1\).
Hence \(x = \pm\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\), \(y = \pm\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}\), \(z = \pm\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\).

Q5b.en:
Let \(u = x^{\cos x}\) and \(v = (\sin x)^x\), so \(y = u + v\) and \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{du}{dx} + \frac{dv}{dx}\).
For \(u\): taking logarithms, \(\log u = \cos x \log x\). Differentiating with respect to \(x\):
\(\frac{1}{u}\frac{du}{dx} = -\sin x \log x + \frac{\cos x}{x}\), so \(\frac{du}{dx} = x^{\cos x}\left(\frac{\cos x}{x} - \sin x \log x\right)\).
For \(v\): taking logarithms, \(\log v = x \log \sin x\). Differentiating with respect to \(x\):
\(\frac{1}{v}\frac{dv}{dx} = \log \sin x + x \cdot \frac{\cos x}{\sin x} = \log \sin x + x\cot x\), so \(\frac{dv}{dx} = (\sin x)^x(\log \sin x + x\cot x)\).
Hence \(\frac{dy}{dx} = x^{\cos x}\left(\frac{\cos x}{x} - \sin x \log x\right) + (\sin x)^x(\log \sin x + x\cot x)\).
Q5b.hi:
माना \(u = x^{\cos x}\) तथा \(v = (\sin x)^x\), तब \(y = u + v\) तथा \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{du}{dx} + \frac{dv}{dx}\)।
\(u\) के लिए: लघुगणक लेने पर \(\log u = \cos x \log x\)। \(x\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{1}{u}\frac{du}{dx} = -\sin x \log x + \frac{\cos x}{x}\), अतः \(\frac{du}{dx} = x^{\cos x}\left(\frac{\cos x}{x} - \sin x \log x\right)\)।
\(v\) के लिए: लघुगणक लेने पर \(\log v = x \log \sin x\)। \(x\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{1}{v}\frac{dv}{dx} = \log \sin x + x \cdot \frac{\cos x}{\sin x} = \log \sin x + x\cot x\), अतः \(\frac{dv}{dx} = (\sin x)^x(\log \sin x + x\cot x)\)।
अतः \(\frac{dy}{dx} = x^{\cos x}\left(\frac{\cos x}{x} - \sin x \log x\right) + (\sin x)^x(\log \sin x + x\cot x)\)।

Q5c.en:
Comparing with \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_1 + \mu\vec{b}_1\) and \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_2 + \lambda\vec{b}_2\):
\(\vec{a}_1 = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \hat{k}\), \(\vec{b}_1 = 3\hat{i} - 5\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\), \(\vec{a}_2 = \hat{i} + \hat{j}\), \(\vec{b}_2 = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\).
The shortest distance is \(d = \left|\frac{(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1)}{|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2|}\right|\).
\(\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1 = -\hat{i} + 0\hat{j} + \hat{k}\).
\(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2 = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 3 & -5 & 2 \\ 2 & -1 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(-5 + 2) - \hat{j}(3 - 4) + \hat{k}(-3 + 10) = -3\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 7\hat{k}\).
\(|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2| = \sqrt{9 + 1 + 49} = \sqrt{59}\).
\((\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1) = (-3)(-1) + (1)(0) + (7)(1) = 10\).
Hence the shortest distance is \(d = \frac{10}{\sqrt{59}}\) units.

Q5d.en:
Minimise \(Z = 3x + y\) subject to \(x + y \le 8\), \(3x + 5y \ge 0\), \(x \ge 0\), \(y \ge 0\).
Step 1: Draw the line \(x + y = 8\), which meets the axes at \((8, 0)\) and \((0, 8)\). The origin satisfies \(x + y \le 8\), so the region lies on the origin side of this line.
Step 2: The line \(3x + 5y = 0\) passes through the origin. For \(x \ge 0\), \(y \ge 0\) we always have \(3x + 5y \ge 0\), so this constraint holds everywhere in the first quadrant and does not cut the region further.
Step 3: The feasible region is therefore the triangle with corner points \(O(0, 0)\), \((8, 0)\) and \((0, 8)\), which is bounded.
Step 4: Value of \(Z\) at the corner points:

| Corner point | \(Z = 3x + y\) |
|---|---|
| \((0, 0)\) | 0 |
| \((8, 0)\) | 24 |
| \((0, 8)\) | 8 |

Hence the minimum value of \(Z\) is 0, at the point \((0, 0)\).
Q5d.hi:

Q5e.en:
Here \(f(x) = \frac{x}{1 + x}\) for \(x \ge 0\) and \(f(x) = \frac{x}{1 - x}\) for \(x < 0\). Note that \(f(x) \ge 0\) when \(x \ge 0\) and \(f(x) < 0\) when \(x < 0\), and \(|f(x)| = \frac{|x|}{1 + |x|} < 1\), so \(f\) does map \(R\) into \((-1, 1)\).
One-one: let \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\). Since \(f(x)\) has the same sign as \(x\), the numbers \(x_1\) and \(x_2\) are both \(\ge 0\) or both \(< 0\).
Case 1, \(x_1, x_2 \ge 0\): \(\frac{x_1}{1 + x_1} = \frac{x_2}{1 + x_2}\) gives \(x_1 + x_1x_2 = x_2 + x_1x_2\), so \(x_1 = x_2\).
Case 2, \(x_1, x_2 < 0\): \(\frac{x_1}{1 - x_1} = \frac{x_2}{1 - x_2}\) gives \(x_1 - x_1x_2 = x_2 - x_1x_2\), so \(x_1 = x_2\).
So \(f\) is one-one.
Onto: let \(y \in (-1, 1)\).
If \(0 \le y < 1\), take \(x = \frac{y}{1 - y} \ge 0\). Then \(f(x) = \frac{\frac{y}{1 - y}}{1 + \frac{y}{1 - y}} = \frac{\frac{y}{1 - y}}{\frac{1}{1 - y}} = y\).
If \(-1 < y < 0\), take \(x = \frac{y}{1 + y} < 0\) (as \(1 + y > 0\)). Then \(f(x) = \frac{\frac{y}{1 + y}}{1 - \frac{y}{1 + y}} = \frac{\frac{y}{1 + y}}{\frac{1}{1 + y}} = y\).
So every element of \((-1, 1)\) has a pre-image in \(R\), and \(f\) is onto.
Hence \(f\) is one-one and onto.

Q6a.en:
**Note:** The English paper prints the second vector as \(2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - \hat{k}\) and the Hindi paper as \(2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\); with the English vectors the triangle is not right-angled, so the proof below follows the Hindi version, which is the NCERT question, after checking the English one.
The English print: take \(\vec{OP} = 3\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\), \(\vec{OQ} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - \hat{k}\), \(\vec{OR} = \hat{i} - 3\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}\). Then \(\vec{PQ} = -\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}\), \(\vec{QR} = -\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\), \(\vec{RP} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\), with \(|\vec{PQ}|^2 = 19\), \(|\vec{QR}|^2 = 21\), \(|\vec{RP}|^2 = 6\). No square equals the sum of the other two (\(19 + 6 = 25 \ne 21\)), so these points do not form a right-angled triangle.
The Hindi print (the intended question): let the vertices be P, Q, R with position vectors
\(\vec{OP} = 3\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\), \(\vec{OQ} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(\vec{OR} = \hat{i} - 3\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}\).
Sides:
\(\vec{PQ} = \vec{OQ} - \vec{OP} = -\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 5\hat{k}\)
\(\vec{QR} = \vec{OR} - \vec{OQ} = -\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} - 6\hat{k}\)
\(\vec{RP} = \vec{OP} - \vec{OR} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\)
Since \(\vec{PQ} + \vec{QR} + \vec{RP} = \vec{0}\) and no two of them are parallel, P, Q, R form a triangle.
Lengths: \(|\vec{PQ}|^2 = 1 + 9 + 25 = 35\), \(|\vec{QR}|^2 = 1 + 4 + 36 = 41\), \(|\vec{RP}|^2 = 4 + 1 + 1 = 6\).
Now \(|\vec{PQ}|^2 + |\vec{RP}|^2 = 35 + 6 = 41 = |\vec{QR}|^2\).
Also \(\vec{RP} \cdot \vec{PQ} = (2)(-1) + (-1)(3) + (1)(5) = 0\), so the sides PQ and PR are perpendicular.
Hence the triangle is right-angled at P, and the given vectors are the position vectors of the vertices of a right-angled triangle.
Q6a.hi:
**टिप्पणी:** अंग्रेज़ी प्रश्नपत्र में दूसरा सदिश \(2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - \hat{k}\) तथा हिन्दी प्रश्नपत्र में \(2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\) छपा है; अंग्रेज़ी सदिशों से त्रिभुज समकोण नहीं बनता, अतः अंग्रेज़ी रूप की जाँच के बाद नीचे का प्रमाण हिन्दी रूप (जो NCERT का प्रश्न है) के अनुसार है।
अंग्रेज़ी रूप: माना \(\vec{OP} = 3\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\), \(\vec{OQ} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - \hat{k}\), \(\vec{OR} = \hat{i} - 3\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}\)। तब \(\vec{PQ} = -\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}\), \(\vec{QR} = -\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\), \(\vec{RP} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\), तथा \(|\vec{PQ}|^2 = 19\), \(|\vec{QR}|^2 = 21\), \(|\vec{RP}|^2 = 6\)। कोई भी वर्ग शेष दो के योग के बराबर नहीं है (\(19 + 6 = 25 \ne 21\)), अतः ये बिन्दु समकोण त्रिभुज नहीं बनाते।

\(\vec{QR} = \vec{OR} - \vec{OQ} = -\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} - 6\hat{k}\)

लम्बाइयाँ: \(|\vec{PQ}|^2 = 1 + 9 + 25 = 35\), \(|\vec{QR}|^2 = 1 + 4 + 36 = 41\), \(|\vec{RP}|^2 = 4 + 1 + 1 = 6\)।
अब \(|\vec{PQ}|^2 + |\vec{RP}|^2 = 35 + 6 = 41 = |\vec{QR}|^2\)।
साथ ही \(\vec{RP} \cdot \vec{PQ} = (2)(-1) + (-1)(3) + (1)(5) = 0\), अतः भुजाएँ PQ तथा PR परस्पर लम्बवत् हैं।
अतः त्रिभुज P पर समकोण है, और दिए गए सदिश एक समकोण त्रिभुज के शीर्षों के स्थिति सदिश हैं।

Q6b.en:
Given \(x\sqrt{1 + y} + y\sqrt{1 + x} = 0\), so \(x\sqrt{1 + y} = -y\sqrt{1 + x}\).
Squaring both sides: \(x^2(1 + y) = y^2(1 + x)\)
\(x^2 - y^2 + x^2y - xy^2 = 0\)
\((x - y)(x + y) + xy(x - y) = 0\)
\((x - y)(x + y + xy) = 0\).
If \(x = y\), the given equation becomes \(2x\sqrt{1 + x} = 0\), which holds only at \(x = 0\); so for the curve \(x \ne y\), and therefore \(x + y + xy = 0\).
Then \(y(1 + x) = -x\), so \(y = -\frac{x}{1 + x}\).
Differentiating with respect to \(x\) by the quotient rule:
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{(1 + x)\cdot 1 - x \cdot 1}{(1 + x)^2} = -\frac{1}{(1 + x)^2}\).
Hence proved.
Q6b.hi:
दिया है \(x\sqrt{1 + y} + y\sqrt{1 + x} = 0\), अतः \(x\sqrt{1 + y} = -y\sqrt{1 + x}\)।
दोनों पक्षों का वर्ग करने पर: \(x^2(1 + y) = y^2(1 + x)\)
\(x^2 - y^2 + x^2y - xy^2 = 0\)
\((x - y)(x + y) + xy(x - y) = 0\)
\((x - y)(x + y + xy) = 0\)।
यदि \(x = y\), तो दिया गया समीकरण \(2x\sqrt{1 + x} = 0\) हो जाता है, जो केवल \(x = 0\) पर सत्य है; अतः \(x \ne y\), इसलिए \(x + y + xy = 0\)।
तब \(y(1 + x) = -x\), अर्थात् \(y = -\frac{x}{1 + x}\)।
\(x\) के सापेक्ष भागफल नियम से अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{(1 + x)\cdot 1 - x \cdot 1}{(1 + x)^2} = -\frac{1}{(1 + x)^2}\)।
इति सिद्धम्।

Q6c.en:
Let E be the event that the first ball is white and F the event that the second ball is white.
The bag has 15 balls, 10 of them white, so \(P(E) = \frac{10}{15}\).
The first white ball is not replaced, so 14 balls remain, 9 of them white: \(P(F \mid E) = \frac{9}{14}\).
By the multiplication theorem on probability,
\(P(E \cap F) = P(E) \cdot P(F \mid E) = \frac{10}{15} \times \frac{9}{14} = \frac{90}{210} = \frac{3}{7}\).
So the probability that both balls drawn are white is \(\frac{3}{7}\).
Q6c.hi:
माना E घटना है कि पहली गेंद सफेद है तथा F घटना है कि दूसरी गेंद सफेद है।
थैले में 15 गेंदें हैं, जिनमें 10 सफेद हैं, अतः \(P(E) = \frac{10}{15}\)।
पहली सफेद गेंद वापस नहीं रखी जाती, अतः 14 गेंदें बचती हैं जिनमें 9 सफेद हैं: \(P(F \mid E) = \frac{9}{14}\)।
प्रायिकता के गुणन प्रमेय से,
\(P(E \cap F) = P(E) \cdot P(F \mid E) = \frac{10}{15} \times \frac{9}{14} = \frac{90}{210} = \frac{3}{7}\)।
अतः दोनों सफेद गेंद निकालने की प्रायिकता \(\frac{3}{7}\) है।

Q6d.en:
Case 1: if \(\vec{a} = \vec{0}\) or \(\vec{b} = \vec{0}\), then \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 0\) and \(|\vec{a}|\,|\vec{b}| = 0\), so \(|\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}| = |\vec{a}|\,|\vec{b}|\) and the inequality holds.
Case 2: if \(\vec{a} \ne \vec{0}\) and \(\vec{b} \ne \vec{0}\), let \(\theta\) be the angle between them. By definition of the scalar product, \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = |\vec{a}|\,|\vec{b}|\cos\theta\).
Taking moduli: \(|\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}| = |\vec{a}|\,|\vec{b}|\,|\cos\theta|\).
Since \(|\cos\theta| \le 1\) for every \(\theta\), and \(|\vec{a}|\,|\vec{b}| > 0\),
\(|\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}| \le |\vec{a}|\,|\vec{b}|\).
In both cases \(|\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}| \le |\vec{a}|\,|\vec{b}|\), with equality when the vectors are parallel or one of them is zero. Hence proved.
Q6d.hi:
स्थिति 1: यदि \(\vec{a} = \vec{0}\) या \(\vec{b} = \vec{0}\), तो \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 0\) तथा \(|\vec{a}|\,|\vec{b}| = 0\), अतः \(|\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}| = |\vec{a}|\,|\vec{b}|\) और असमिका सत्य है।
स्थिति 2: यदि \(\vec{a} \ne \vec{0}\) तथा \(\vec{b} \ne \vec{0}\), तो माना इनके बीच का कोण \(\theta\) है। अदिश गुणनफल की परिभाषा से \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = |\vec{a}|\,|\vec{b}|\cos\theta\)।
मापांक लेने पर: \(|\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}| = |\vec{a}|\,|\vec{b}|\,|\cos\theta|\)।
चूँकि प्रत्येक \(\theta\) के लिए \(|\cos\theta| \le 1\) तथा \(|\vec{a}|\,|\vec{b}| > 0\),
\(|\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}| \le |\vec{a}|\,|\vec{b}|\)।
दोनों स्थितियों में \(|\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}| \le |\vec{a}|\,|\vec{b}|\), तथा समता तब होती है जब सदिश समान्तर हों या उनमें से एक शून्य सदिश हो। इति सिद्धम्।

Q6e.en:
Factorise the denominator: \(x^3 - x^2 - x + 1 = x^2(x - 1) - (x - 1) = (x - 1)(x^2 - 1) = (x - 1)^2(x + 1)\).
Write in partial fractions: \(\frac{3x + 5}{(x - 1)^2(x + 1)} = \frac{p}{x - 1} + \frac{q}{(x - 1)^2} + \frac{r}{x + 1}\).
Then \(3x + 5 = p(x - 1)(x + 1) + q(x + 1) + r(x - 1)^2\).
Putting \(x = 1\): \(8 = 2q\), so \(q = 4\).
Putting \(x = -1\): \(2 = 4r\), so \(r = \frac{1}{2}\).
Comparing coefficients of \(x^2\): \(0 = p + r\), so \(p = -\frac{1}{2}\). (Check, constant terms: \(-p + q + r = \frac{1}{2} + 4 + \frac{1}{2} = 5\).)
So \(\int \frac{3x + 5}{x^3 - x^2 - x + 1}\, dx = -\frac{1}{2}\int \frac{dx}{x - 1} + 4\int \frac{dx}{(x - 1)^2} + \frac{1}{2}\int \frac{dx}{x + 1}\)
\(= -\frac{1}{2}\log|x - 1| - \frac{4}{x - 1} + \frac{1}{2}\log|x + 1| + C\)
\(= \frac{1}{2}\log\left|\frac{x + 1}{x - 1}\right| - \frac{4}{x - 1} + C\).

Q7a.en:
\(A = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 3 & 1 \\ 3 & 4 & 1 \\ 4 & 3 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\).
Determinant (expanding along the first row):
\(|A| = 3(4 - 3) - 3(3 - 4) + 1(9 - 16) = 3 + 3 - 7 = -1\).
Cofactors \(A_{ij}\):
\(A_{11} = +(4 \cdot 1 - 1 \cdot 3) = 1\), \(A_{12} = -(3 \cdot 1 - 1 \cdot 4) = 1\), \(A_{13} = +(3 \cdot 3 - 4 \cdot 4) = -7\)
\(A_{21} = -(3 \cdot 1 - 1 \cdot 3) = 0\), \(A_{22} = +(3 \cdot 1 - 1 \cdot 4) = -1\), \(A_{23} = -(3 \cdot 3 - 3 \cdot 4) = 3\)
\(A_{31} = +(3 \cdot 1 - 1 \cdot 4) = -1\), \(A_{32} = -(3 \cdot 1 - 1 \cdot 3) = 0\), \(A_{33} = +(3 \cdot 4 - 3 \cdot 3) = 3\)
The adjoint is the transpose of the cofactor matrix:
\(\text{adj } A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 1 & -1 & 0 \\ -7 & 3 & 3 \end{bmatrix}\).
Verification:
\(A(\text{adj } A) = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 3 & 1 \\ 3 & 4 & 1 \\ 4 & 3 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 1 & -1 & 0 \\ -7 & 3 & 3 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 3 + 3 - 7 & 0 - 3 + 3 & -3 + 0 + 3 \\ 3 + 4 - 7 & 0 - 4 + 3 & -3 + 0 + 3 \\ 4 + 3 - 7 & 0 - 3 + 3 & -4 + 0 + 3 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 \end{bmatrix}\).
And \(|A|I = -1\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 \end{bmatrix}\).
Hence \(A(\text{adj } A) = |A|I\). Verified.
Inverse: since \(|A| = -1 \ne 0\), the inverse exists and
\(A^{-1} = \frac{1}{|A|}\text{adj } A = -\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 1 & -1 & 0 \\ -7 & 3 & 3 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -1 & 0 & 1 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 \\ 7 & -3 & -3 \end{bmatrix}\).

Q7b.en:
The third equation is \(x - y + z = 4\). The system in matrix form is \(AX = B\), where
\(A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 2 & 1 & -3 \\ 1 & -1 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\), \(X = \begin{bmatrix} x \\ y \\ z \end{bmatrix}\), \(B = \begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ 0 \\ 4 \end{bmatrix}\).
\(|A| = 1(1 - 3) - 1(2 + 3) + 1(-2 - 1) = -2 - 5 - 3 = -10 \ne 0\), so \(A^{-1}\) exists and the system has a unique solution \(X = A^{-1}B\).
Cofactors:

Q8a.en:
Let \(I = \int_0^{\pi/4} \log_e(1 + \tan\theta)\, d\theta\) ... (1)
Using the property \(\int_0^a f(\theta)\, d\theta = \int_0^a f(a - \theta)\, d\theta\) with \(a = \frac{\pi}{4}\):
\(I = \int_0^{\pi/4} \log_e\left(1 + \tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - \theta\right)\right) d\theta\).
Now \(\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - \theta\right) = \frac{1 - \tan\theta}{1 + \tan\theta}\), so \(1 + \tan\left(\frac{\pi}{4} - \theta\right) = \frac{1 + \tan\theta + 1 - \tan\theta}{1 + \tan\theta} = \frac{2}{1 + \tan\theta}\).
Therefore
\(I = \int_0^{\pi/4} \log_e\frac{2}{1 + \tan\theta}\, d\theta = \int_0^{\pi/4} \log_e 2\, d\theta - \int_0^{\pi/4} \log_e(1 + \tan\theta)\, d\theta\)
\(I = \frac{\pi}{4}\log_e 2 - I\) (using (1)).
So \(2I = \frac{\pi}{4}\log_e 2\), and \(I = \frac{\pi}{8}\log_e 2\).
Hence \(\int_0^{\pi/4} \log_e(1 + \tan\theta)\, d\theta = \frac{\pi}{8}\log_e 2\). Proved.

Q8b.en:
Let the given cone have base radius \(R\) and height \(H\) (both fixed). Let a right circular cylinder of radius \(r\) and height \(h\) be inscribed in it, its base on the base of the cone and its top rim touching the slant surface.
In the vertical section through the axis, the triangle above the top of the cylinder is similar to the whole triangle of the cone, so
\(\frac{r}{R} = \frac{H - h}{H}\), which gives \(h = \frac{H(R - r)}{R}\).
The curved surface area of the cylinder is
\(S = 2\pi rh = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(Rr - r^2)\), where \(0 < r < R\).
Differentiating with respect to \(r\):
\(\frac{dS}{dr} = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(R - 2r)\).
For a maximum or minimum, \(\frac{dS}{dr} = 0\), so \(R - 2r = 0\), that is \(r = \frac{R}{2}\).
Second derivative: \(\frac{d^2S}{dr^2} = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(-2) = -\frac{4\pi H}{R} < 0\).
So \(S\) is maximum when \(r = \frac{R}{2}\).
Hence the radius of the cylinder of maximum curved surface inscribed in a cone is half the radius of the cone. Proved.
Q8b.hi:
माना दिए गए शंकु के आधार की त्रिज्या \(R\) तथा ऊँचाई \(H\) है (दोनों अचर)। माना शंकु के अन्तर्गत त्रिज्या \(r\) तथा ऊँचाई \(h\) का एक लम्ब-वृत्तीय बेलन है, जिसका आधार शंकु के आधार पर है और ऊपरी किनारा शंकु के तिर्यक पृष्ठ को छूता है।
अक्ष से होकर जाने वाले ऊर्ध्वाधर परिच्छेद में बेलन के ऊपर का त्रिभुज शंकु के पूरे त्रिभुज के समरूप है, अतः
\(\frac{r}{R} = \frac{H - h}{H}\), जिससे \(h = \frac{H(R - r)}{R}\)।
बेलन का वक्र पृष्ठ
\(S = 2\pi rh = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(Rr - r^2)\), जहाँ \(0 < r < R\)।
\(r\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{dS}{dr} = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(R - 2r)\)।
उच्चिष्ठ या निम्निष्ठ के लिए \(\frac{dS}{dr} = 0\), अतः \(R - 2r = 0\), अर्थात् \(r = \frac{R}{2}\)।
द्वितीय अवकलज: \(\frac{d^2S}{dr^2} = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(-2) = -\frac{4\pi H}{R} < 0\)।
अतः \(r = \frac{R}{2}\) पर \(S\) महत्तम है।
अतः शंकु के अन्तर्गत महत्तम वक्र पृष्ठ वाले लम्ब-वृत्तीय बेलन की त्रिज्या शंकु की त्रिज्या की आधी होती है। इति सिद्धम्।

Q9aii.en:
The ellipse \(\frac{x^2}{16} + \frac{y^2}{25} = 1\) has \(a = 4\) along the x-axis and \(b = 5\) along the y-axis, and it is symmetric about both axes. So the whole area is 4 times the area in the first quadrant.
In the first quadrant, \(y = \frac{5}{4}\sqrt{16 - x^2}\), for \(0 \le x \le 4\).
Area \(= 4\int_0^4 \frac{5}{4}\sqrt{16 - x^2}\, dx = 5\int_0^4 \sqrt{16 - x^2}\, dx\)
\(= 5\left[\frac{x}{2}\sqrt{16 - x^2} + \frac{16}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{x}{4}\right]_0^4\)
\(= 5\left[(0 + 8\sin^{-1} 1) - (0 + 0)\right] = 5 \times 8 \times \frac{\pi}{2} = 20\pi\).
Hence the area bounded by the ellipse is \(20\pi\) square units.
Q9aii.hi:
दीर्घवृत्त \(\frac{x^2}{16} + \frac{y^2}{25} = 1\) में x-अक्ष के अनुदिश \(a = 4\) तथा y-अक्ष के अनुदिश \(b = 5\) है, और यह दोनों अक्षों के सापेक्ष सममित है। अतः सम्पूर्ण क्षेत्रफल प्रथम चतुर्थांश के क्षेत्रफल का 4 गुना है।
प्रथम चतुर्थांश में \(y = \frac{5}{4}\sqrt{16 - x^2}\), जहाँ \(0 \le x \le 4\)।
क्षेत्रफल \(= 4\int_0^4 \frac{5}{4}\sqrt{16 - x^2}\, dx = 5\int_0^4 \sqrt{16 - x^2}\, dx\)
\(= 5\left[\frac{x}{2}\sqrt{16 - x^2} + \frac{16}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{x}{4}\right]_0^4\)
\(= 5\left[(0 + 8\sin^{-1} 1) - (0 + 0)\right] = 5 \times 8 \times \frac{\pi}{2} = 20\pi\)।
अतः दीर्घवृत्त से घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल \(20\pi\) वर्ग इकाई है।

Q9b.en:
Let \(I = \int \frac{\sec^2 2\theta\, d\theta}{(\cot\theta - \tan\theta)^2}\).
First simplify the denominator:
\(\cot\theta - \tan\theta = \frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta} - \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta} = \frac{\cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta}{\sin\theta\cos\theta} = \frac{\cos 2\theta}{\frac{1}{2}\sin 2\theta} = 2\cot 2\theta\).
So \((\cot\theta - \tan\theta)^2 = 4\cot^2 2\theta\), and
\(I = \int \frac{\sec^2 2\theta}{4\cot^2 2\theta}\, d\theta = \frac{1}{4}\int \tan^2 2\theta\, \sec^2 2\theta\, d\theta\).
Put \(\tan 2\theta = t\). Then \(2\sec^2 2\theta\, d\theta = dt\), so \(\sec^2 2\theta\, d\theta = \frac{dt}{2}\).
\(I = \frac{1}{4}\int t^2 \cdot \frac{dt}{2} = \frac{1}{8} \cdot \frac{t^3}{3} + C = \frac{t^3}{24} + C\).
Hence \(I = \frac{1}{24}\tan^3 2\theta + C\).
